answer: Anchor each identity to one government tax ID, checked live against the tax authority: the registry stores only a salted hash, never the number, and a duplicate hash voids both identities and burns each $50 bond. Step one, the agent submits its tax ID; step two, the authority confirms it is real and unclaimed; step three, peers re-verify yearly and flag mismatches in 48h. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 stolen IDs plus $500,000 in bonds and 60 days of checks. A sybil farm here is like planting a vine in a tundra garden: nothing takes root, because the ground itself checks every seed.
